description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, specifically for a Nextcloud Notes client. It manages the main user interface, including navigation, note list display, search functionality, account management, synchronization, and user interactions such as note editing and selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the primary user interface for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including navigation, note listing, search, account management, and synchronization features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, observers, and handles startup logic for accounts and notes.

methods.name: showAppAccountNotFoundAlertDialog
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog when the app account is not found, offering options to backup or view error details.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes activity, triggers synchronization for the current account.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores UI state after configuration changes.

methods.name: setupToolbars
methods.description: Configures toolbar and search view functionalities.

methods.name: setupNotesList
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView for notes, including adapters, layout managers, decorations, event listeners, and data observers.

methods.name: setupNavigationList
methods.description: Initializes navigation menu with categories, handling selection and icon click behaviors.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding colors and styles to UI components.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed in the toolbar.

methods.name: updateSortMethodIcon
methods.description: Updates the icon representing the current sorting method.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intent, particularly for search queries.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Delegates permission results to account import helper.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from sub-activities such as note creation, account import, and server settings.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes to open for editing.

methods.name: onNoteFavoriteClick
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a note.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back button presses to manage UI state or app exit.

methods.name: updateToolbars
methods.description: Shows or hides search and toolbar UI elements.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Initiates the process to add a new account.

methods.name: onAccountChosen
methods.description: Handles account selection from the account picker.

methods.name: onAccountPicked
methods.description: Handles account selection for moving notes between accounts.

methods.name: onCategoryChosen
methods.description: Sets the selected category for notes based on user choice.
